blurb: Bowlerama offers bowling lanes for open play, timed bowling, leagues, and hosts parties including birthdays, corporate events, and social gatherings. The facility includes a KidZone with a secure arcade and private birthday suites. On-site dining options include The Spare Rib restaurant and Kegler's Pub & Sports Bar.
